triples.context: Designing climate adaptation strategies is difficult because effective measures are (i)sequentialand long-lived infras- tructure decisions, (ii) evaluated underdeep uncertaintyabout future climate conditions, and (iii) embedded in coupled sys- tems where hazard dynamics, network performance, and im- pacts interact.
